prompts.initial:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished Open Graph sharing image for Civica Atlas, landscape 1200 × 630 pixels, roughly 1.91:1 aspect ratio, full canvas artwork, no mockup frame. This is option 1, 'The engraved atlas', but DO NOT print the option name.
Brand source: Civica's CURRENT fine-press almanac design system: warm ivory #FAF7F2 paper, ink-navy #0B1B2D typography, a restrained terracotta #B7512B accent, hairline rules, exquisitely detailed antique engraved illustration. Newsreader Light serif for display, Archivo sans serif for small text. This is an elegant contemporary scholarly reference, never a tech dashboard or vintage distressed poster.
Composition: asymmetrical editorial cover, left 57% a calm ivory text field, right 43% an extraordinary navy copperplate engraving of an old terrestrial globe on a simple stand, graceful meridians and recognisable continents, fading naturally into the paper toward the text, very fine controlled hatching. No country borders or labels. The globe is decorative.
Set 'Civica Atlas' near upper left in a beautiful generously sized Newsreader-style serif wordmark. Below, the principal headline occupies three large airy lines: 'How every' / 'country is' / 'governed.' Set with light, crisp high-contrast serif, plenty of optical whitespace; readable in a small X card. Tiny terracotta hairline and subtle small Archivo line at lower left: 'Country profiles. Sources. Context.' Along the bottom a fine rule and 'civicaatlas.org' in clean sans serif. The brand and headline must be dominant, engraving supports them.
Only exact text allowed: 'Civica Atlas', 'How every country is governed.', 'Country profiles. Sources. Context.', 'civicaatlas.org'. No invented icon or logo, no pseudo seals, no other words, no counts, no claims of comprehensiveness, no map data, no charts, no Index or Pulse. No monospace, gradients, bevels, offset shadows, rounded container, banners or busy UI. Min 55px safe margin at 1200px width. Visually impeccable professional typography and refined hierarchy.
prompts.approvedTextEdit: Edit the attached approved Civica Atlas social sharing image. Preserve the ivory paper background, navy engraved globe with its stand/books/coastline on the right, brand wordmark, terracotta rules, overall composition, typography style and color. Change ONLY the headline and supporting line as follows. Replace 'How every country is governed.' with the exact headline 'A world atlas of government.' arranged in three elegant large serif lines: 'A world' / 'atlas of' / 'government.' Keep it within the left text field and do not overlap the globe. Replace 'Country profiles. Sources. Context.' with the exact supporting line 'Institutions, constitutions, elections—and their sources.' in clean Archivo-style sans serif. It may wrap naturally over TWO lines so it is easily readable in the left field; adjust the small terracotta line and bottom domain line slightly if needed to retain balanced breathing room and safe margins. Preserve 'Civica Atlas' and 'civicaatlas.org' exactly. No additional text. Keep the full canvas fully opaque warm ivory #FAF7F2; absolutely no transparency. Keep the selected antique engraving, layout and style. Finished flat sharing image, no mockup. Target 1200 by 630 aspect ratio (1.905:1). This is the approved production wording, so spelling and punctuation must be exact.
